systems.owner: National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA), under the Ministry of Internal Affairs
systems.tiers: registration services stated to be in all 135 districts; 25 districts served by one NIRA staff member

note: States that NIRA's registration services reach all 135 districts and that 25 districts have one member of staff (August 2026), and that the public seek civil registration services at headquarters; it does not say that any office records births or deaths digitally, and names no civil registration system.
